sonuc.drug_name: Onpattro 2 mg/mL concentrate for solution for infusion

what_for.text: Onpattro treats an inherited illness called hATTR amyloidosis.
what_for.evidence: Onpattro is a medicine that treats an illness which runs in families called hereditary transthyretin-mediated amyloidosis (hATTR amyloidosis).

what_for.text: Onpattro lowers the amount of TTR protein made by your liver.
what_for.evidence: Onpattro works by lowering the amount of TTR protein that the liver makes.

how_to_use.text: It is given as a drip into a vein every 3 weeks.
how_to_use.evidence: The usual dose of Onpattro is 300 micrograms per kilogram (kg) of body weight given once every 3 weeks.

how_to_use.text: A doctor or nurse will give you the infusion over 80 minutes.
how_to_use.evidence: Onpattro will be given to you by a doctor or nurse. ... It is given as a drip into a vein (‘intravenous infusion’) usually over about 80 minutes.

how_to_use.text: You will get other medicines 60 minutes before to prevent reactions.
how_to_use.evidence: About 60 minutes before each infusion of Onpattro, you will be given medicines that help to lower the risk of infusion-related reactions

how_to_use.text: Take a daily vitamin A supplement during treatment with Onpattro.
how_to_use.evidence: Your doctor will ask you to take a daily vitamin A supplement during treatment with Onpattro.

how_to_use.text: If you miss an appointment, ask your doctor or nurse when to rebook.
how_to_use.evidence: If you miss an appointment to have Onpattro, ask your doctor or nurse when to book your next treatment.

see_doctor_now.text: Tell your doctor straight away if you get signs of an infusion reaction.
see_doctor_now.evidence: Tell your doctor or nurse straight away if you get any signs of an infusion-related reaction.

see_doctor_now.text: Talk to your doctor if you have eye or vision problems while using Onpattro.
see_doctor_now.evidence: If you have problems with your vision or any other eye problems whilst using Onpattro, you should talk to your doctor.

side_effects.text: Infusion reactions like stomach pain, headache, chills, or dizziness are very common.
side_effects.evidence: Infusion-related reactions are very common (may affect more than 1 in 10 people). ... Stomach pain ... Feeling sick (nausea) ... Body aches or pain, including pain in the back, neck, or joints ... Headache ... Feeling tired (fatigue) ... Chills ... Dizziness

side_effects.text: Swelling of your arms or legs.
side_effects.evidence: Swelling of the arms or legs (peripheral oedema)

side_effects.text: Joint pain, muscle spasms, indigestion, and shortness of breath.
side_effects.evidence: Pain in the joints (arthralgia) ... Muscle spasms ... Indigestion (dyspepsia) ... Shortness of breath (dyspnoea)

storage.text: Store in a refrigerator between 2°C and 8°C. Do not freeze.
storage.evidence: Store in a refrigerator (2°C to 8°C). Do not freeze.

storage.text: If refrigeration is unavailable, Onpattro can be kept up to 25°C for 14 days.
storage.evidence: If refrigeration is not available, Onpattro can be stored at room temperature (up to 25°C) for up to 14 days.

storage.text: Keep this medicine out of the sight and reach of children.
storage.evidence: Keep this medicine out of the sight and reach of children.
